translations.answer: The Article argues that it is not a single model, but a (policy/model, embodiment, task, environment) tuple, and includes action/state space, control frequency, URDF/MJCF, calibration, safety limits, simulation configuration, training execution, and real-world results. It is a community architecture proposal, but is very suitable as a candidate data contract.
translations.applicability: Applicable for establishing a WBC engineering problem and a query system for reproducible bundles.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent reproducibility is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: The article proposes four categories of registry/bundle mechanisms.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Bind action/state space, control frequency, body, task, environment, URDF, calibration, safety limits, and results together.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: The candidate data model is versioned, complete deployment bundle, and associated with real-world/simulation results and community reproducibility.
translations.details.environments.0: Cross-strategy, body, task, environment; Franka/UR5/LeRobot examples.
translations.details.limits.0: The article's examples and 30% statement should be verified against the original links.
translations.details.outcomes.0: It is an architectural suggestion, not yet deployed platform.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Only code/weights cannot reproduce robot results.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Public bundles should not omit safety limits, calibration version, and known invalid boundaries.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The robot value unit is a complete tuple, but current hub only focuses on model-centric approach.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Training loss is normal, but success rate is 0%; selecting the wrong URDF causes Sim2Real failure; old simulation configuration cannot be re-run.
translations.media_summaries.0: Screenshot shows the Article title, TL;DR, and flowchart; the flowchart only explains the article structure, and the four categories of artifact must be referred to the text.
translations.source.title: The Minimum Unit for Reproducibility in Robotics is Not a Model, but a Complete Deployment Tuple
